claims_boundary: Public signals define candidate problem classes only. They do not establish Boeing root cause, Worldshepherd adoption, or real-world solution effectiveness.

public_sources.title: Mid-Level - Quality Assurance Supplier - APQP Rep
public_sources.signal: APQP/PPAP, Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, FAI, supplier QMS, audits, NOE and 8D closure

public_sources.title: Mid-Level - Quality Assurance Supplier - Product and Process Verification Representative
public_sources.signal: supplier planning versus engineering requirements, product/process audits, RCCA closure, SAP/MES

public_sources.title: Mid-Level - Quality Assurance Configuration Verification
public_sources.signal: customer configuration requirements, BOM analysis, engineering changes, build records, open work and shipping documents

problem_classes.name: Requirement flow-down gap
problem_classes.worldshepherd_control: SARA requirement-to-evidence graph with PRIME fail-closed release gate
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: Every predeclared applicable engineering/customer/contract requirement resolves to supplier planning evidence or an approved exception

problem_classes.name: Configuration / revision inconsistency
problem_classes.worldshepherd_control: Configuration lineage reconciler across engineering revision, supplier planning revision, BOM and build record
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: No release when a controlled revision mismatch or unresolved configuration inconsistency is present

problem_classes.name: Incomplete APQP/PPAP evidence
problem_classes.worldshepherd_control: APQP evidence compiler for Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA and FAI
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: All applicable APQP evidence objects are present, current, source-bound and reviewable

problem_classes.name: Supplier product/process verification gap
problem_classes.worldshepherd_control: Product/process verification record with audit finding and requirement lineage
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: Unresolved major/critical PPV findings block release

problem_classes.name: Open escape / RCCA / 8D
problem_classes.worldshepherd_control: Escape-to-containment-to-RCCA evidence graph with effectiveness and closure gates
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: A required escape/RCCA record cannot be treated as closed without retained closure evidence

problem_classes.name: Open work or incomplete shipment evidence
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: Open work and required shipment-document gaps are visible and block release unless formally dispositioned

problem_classes.name: Stale or untrusted quality evidence
problem_classes.worldshepherd_control: ECHO source/timestamp/digest custody plus evidence-debt monitoring
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: Every decision-driving evidence object carries provenance, time, integrity and review status

problem_classes.name: Schedule pressure bypasses quality gate
problem_classes.worldshepherd_control: PRIME policy gate and human-authority separation
problem_classes.acceptance_metric: A schedule/production override cannot silently convert a blocked record to releasable

non_target_problems: Off-market customer-contract economics and acquisition purchase-price allocation
Physical manufacturing defects not observable from available evidence
Replacement of Boeing/Spirit authoritative production systems
